premises.text: Medication adherence is a costly problem in health care, leading to significant costs and deaths.
premises.evidence_span: Medication adherence is arguably the most costly problem in health care today, leading to about $300 billion in costs, $100 billion in lost revenues, and 125,000 deaths in the U.S. alone every year.

premises.text: The AdhereTech bottle collects data on medication usage to improve adherence.
premises.evidence_span: Every time the patient uses the bottle, it sends two pieces of data into the cloud.

premises.text: Interventions are triggered when patients do not take their medications as scheduled.
premises.evidence_span: if we notice a discrepancy, like the patient didn't take their pills, then we intervene

premises.text: The bottle is designed to be easy to use and does not require syncing to Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.
premises.evidence_span: the bottle automatically sends all data over the Verizon data network. This means that patients don't have to sync it to Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.

premises.text: The business model involves partnering with pharma companies to distribute high-cost drugs.
premises.evidence_span: our business model is to partner with specialty pharma companies to distribute high-cost drugs in our bottle.

premises.text: Patients receive the bottle free of charge for certain high-cost specialty medications.
premises.evidence_span: Patients will get this bottle from the specialty pharmacy completely free of charge for certain high-cost specialty meds.

premises.text: AdhereTech collects accurate and granular data on medication adherence.
premises.evidence_span: we collect the most accurate and granular data out there.

value.text: Patients improve medication adherence and engagement through the use of smart pill bottles.
